newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso snaps six-day upward streak.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso snaps six-day upward streak.

text.p: Colombia's peso snapped a six-day upward streak and closed slightly lower despite what dealers described as a continuing abundance of dollars on the country's interbank market.
The peso, which traded in a 1,034.20 to 1,036.90 range, closed at 1,035.65, down 65 centavos from Tuesday's close, dealers said.
They said it was widely expected to resume its upward trend later this week, however, since dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters were sure to give it near-term support.
Dealers reported 276 trades in Wednesday's session for a total of $115 million.
